items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Hilton called me, Hilton Ruiz, I helped him, piano. He was doing all this with his hands up too high. I said, 'You better drop your hands down on those keys.'

ctx.x: of happy I got away from them. But that's the reason why I'm afraid if I played the classics and went all the way with it I'd lose the feeling of the greatest (now I'm not putting the classics down) - the greatest music that I think has ever been -'cause I can write the classics and everything here. I can write that too you know, once I get into it. One day - my husband, he was kind of mean, said, "You better save your money 'cause you'll be old." Here I'm 22 - "and you won't be able to play."
